verses.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּהוּ כָּל־ הָאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kāl- gō·w·yim šab·bə·ḥû·hû kāl- hā·’um·mîm
verses.literal: Praise the LORD all you nations Extol Him all you peoples

verses.original: כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ׀ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶֽאֱמֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḡā·ḇar ‘ā·lê·nū ḥas·dōw we·’ĕ·meṯ- Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: For great is His loving devotion toward us and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever Hallelujah . . .
